```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    nodes_map = {node['id']: node for node in nodes}
    children_map = {}
    for node in nodes:
        parent = node['parent']
        if parent is not None:
            children_map.setdefault(parent, []).append(node['id'])
    # sort nodes by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    retained = set(node['id'] for node in nodes)
    removed = []
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node['id']
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        # check that no children are retained
        children = children_map.get(nid, [])
        if any(child in retained for child in children):
            continue
        # check required symbols after removal
        new_retained = retained - {nid}
        # compute symbols in new_retained
        symbols_present = set()
        for rid in new_retained:
            symbols_present.add(nodes_map[rid]['symbol'])
        if all(sym in symbols_present for sym in required_symbols):
            retained = new_retained
            removed.append(nid)
    returned = {
        "removed_node_ids": removed,
        "retained_node_ids": sorted(retained)
    }
    return returned
```
